goal: Duplication review: copied blocks that should share one implementation.
use: Duplication review: copied blocks that should share one implementation. Use when the same logic appears in more than one place.

steps.note: Find copies. Compare the changed blocks with similar code in the repository.
Measure. Note how many copies and how far they have drifted apart.
Check drift. Flag copies where a fix was made in one place only.
Suggest a shared function. Name where the one implementation should live.
Report. Each group of copies with its locations, the drift and the fix.
